newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Yilmaz to meet president in govt search.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Yilmaz to meet president in govt search.

text.p: Turkish President Suleyman Demirel invited opposition leader Mesut Yilmaz to his residence on Friday amid the search for a new prime minister to succeed Islamist Necmettin Erbakan, Anatolian news agency said.
Anatolian said Demirel would hold talks with Yilmaz at 5 p.m. (1400 GMT). It gave no more details of the meeting.

Motherland Party leader Yilmaz is one of the favourites to be appointed as prime minister-designate by Demirel. Conservative Tansu Ciller, a bitter rival of Yilmaz is also in the running for the top job.
Erbakan, NATO member Turkey's first Islamist leader, resigned on Wednesday after months of pressure from the secularist military.
He asked Demirel to approve a plan under which Ciller would head a new coalition with the Islamists to take Turkey to early elections by next spring at the latest.
